Teamtech's complete net allocation is 45.4859 crore. Its later land, building
and machinery cost table describes a project, including costs funded through
other means. It is not a use-of-IPO-proceeds allocation. The summary and full
allocation tables also exercise centred amount cells, wrapped units and a
gross/expense/net reconciliation that continues onto the next PDF page.

Unimech's three subsidiary allocations inherit the observed parent caption.
Its full document remains unresolved in this bounded parser because a later
net-proceeds reconciliation uses an unsupported wrapped label.

Blackbuck and M&B's allocations contradict the same documents' explicit net
proceeds after issuer expenses. Their entire lists remain unresolved. Neither
general corporate purposes nor another allocation is reduced by inference.
